Configuration error

Missing required configuration: ASC_KEY_ID, ASC_ISSUER_ID, ASC_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH (or ASC_PRIVATE_KEY, or ASC_PRIVATE_KEY_KEYCHAIN).
Either run "npx -y @erayendes/asc-mcp setup" once (shared by every profile), or create an API key at https://appstoreconnect.apple.com/access/integrations/api and set these as environment variables in your MCP client config.
